description: Evaluation benchmark for prompt injection defenses in educational LLM tutors.

query_id.description: Unique identifier for each query (format: q_XXXX)

text.description: The query text submitted to the tutoring system

ground_truth.description: Ground-truth label: 'injection' for adversarial prompts, 'benign' for legitimate educational queries

is_injection.description: Boolean equivalent of ground_truth (true = injection, false = benign)

persona.description: Simulated user archetype that generated the query

language.description: Query language: 'en' for English, 'pt' for Portuguese (Brazilian variant)

turn_index.description: Position within a multi-turn exchange (0 = single-turn / first turn)
